title: Geno Smith is on the field at Jets practice Monday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Geno Smith is on the field at Jets practice Monday
sources.description: Geno Smith was a late scratch for the Jets' preseason opener due to a sore ankle, but there was no concern from the team about an extended absence and Monday brought good news about his condition.
